title: BLR acceptance and Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ taking values in $[-1,1]$. For each subset $S$ of the coordinates, let $\\widehat f(S)$ be the uniform average of $f(x)\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$ over the sign cube. The acceptance probability of the original three-query BLR tester on $f$ is $\\frac12+\\frac12\\sum_{S\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}}\\widehat f(S)^3$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
